title: Odd Shapes; How are they Measured?
text:
Odd Shapes; How are they Measured?. Note: There are several products attached to this listing. I am specifically reviewing the 3-pack of bakeware.

My experience with Rubbermaid has been with trash cans and storage containers. This is my first experience with their bakeware and to be honest I am underwhelmed. These have a strange shape to them and may be off a bit on the sizes.

The listing says these are 13"x9", 12"x8", and 8"x8". The issue is that these are not exactly squared off and have odd shapes with curved sides. It is unclear how these are then measured, but even so it become even less clear if these are actually the stated sizes. Are they measured from the corners where the dishes are narrower than the sides, or from the center of each edge where they're widest? Either way, it would skew the size. Maybe there's some weird average taken for each side measurement?

These are definitely lightweight and are easy to clean, though. Compared to a glass 13"x9" dish these are definitely quite a bit lighter and easier to handle. They're a lot easier to wash too which is a nice plus. And, they're dishwasher safe.

I have mixed feelings about these baking dishes. They're made to be lightweight and easy to clean, and in that regard they succeed wonderfully. However, they are shaped a little differently and there's some question regarding their stated sizes.
